title: How Judges weigh monsters
summary: Judges decide, case by case, which creatures to spare.

claims.text: Judges see themselves as deciding the guilt or innocence of each supernatural being, gathering what they can from observation and chosen allies before ruling to condemn or spare.

A creature showing steady hatred or malice is put down, or condemned for others to finish; one showing remorse or disgust at its own state may be spared and even left for others to bring back toward humanity.
Because they judge individuals, Judges have no slang of their own and distrust labels for groups, even the idea of hunter creeds.
Fellow hunters can be surprised when someone taken for a Judge turns out to be a militant Redeemer or a distracted Visionary.
